text:
maya: quick one — the Q2 RICE sheet looks off after the enterprise KMS ask. should we bump impact for Private deploys or split the initiative? 
noah: link to sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/q2-rice (look at rows 23-27)
oliver: my read: impact for Private +KMS is real but delivery effort spikes because of infra+compliance work. effort goes from 3 -> 8 if we include HSM/KMS integration in-phase.
samir: can we decouple? must-have for launch: KMS integrations only for dedicated customers later. do MVP without HSM to keep effort low.
maya: proposal: split into two slices — "Private core" (reach + impact moderate, effort low) and "Private security add-on" (high impact for a few accounts, high effort). keep separate RICE rows.
rachel: also think about sequencing: customers pushing for SLA & audit logs. if we delay KMS, we should at least ship audit logs + RBAC so compliance teams see progress.
oliver: +1 on audit logs early. it buys us time. estimate: Private core effort 4, security add-on 8-9. impact: core 5, add-on 8. reach: core 6, add-on 2. confidence: core 7, add-on 5.
maya: ok that changes RICE ordering — core moves above predictive cache work, add-on sits below model quantization.
noah: patching product criteria: "launchable" = SLA 99.9% baseline, audit logs, per-tenant keys marked as TODO if not present. list out must-have acceptance tests.
samir: engineering risk: if we split, must ensure rollout path supports automatic fallback to hosted model if Private capacity is constrained. that's a runtime dependency.
oliver: we can treat auto-fallback as infra item parallel to core work. effort 3.
maya: decision for this thread: split the ticket and update RICE for both slices. owners: maya (core) and samir (security add-on). can we get quick signoffs? react with :+1: or comment blockers.
rachel: :+1: and will draft the UX caveat about KMS being "coming soon" in console flows.
noah: adding rollout gate in the ticket — can we set canary at 5% traffic for 2 weeks? deploy-bot: scheduled canary created for ticket #PR-572 at 2149998905.
oliver: blocker — we need infra quota for dedicated GPUs for private e2e perf tests. ping infra and finance.
maya: noted. i'll add infra request and update RICE numbers by EOD. thanks all.
